Do not widen functionSymbolName or fabricate a native declaration name. Exclude targetsNativeFunction from the generic external-prototype route, preserving the existing typed native indirect-call route and ordinary unresolved external behavior. Both physical native declarations and imported library calls share that one classifier.

Call-site inventory for functionSymbolName reviewed: codegen grouping excludes imported declarations through isIntrinsicDeclaration; ordinary resolved calls already select native before this writer. Native loading/global emission use explicit imported-interface paths. COM, trait/hash methods and specialized parallel callbacks remain separate consumers; this focused four-call input does not exercise or qualify them.
